description.value: China Kitchen has been a community staple in Maple Ridge since 1990, serving a broad range of Cantonese and Szechuan Chinese dishes across a full dine-in menu and a popular buffet. The restaurant sits on Lougheed Highway and offers both table-service dining and online ordering for takeout. With decades of history in the area, it is one of the longer-established Chinese restaurants on this busy corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at chinakitchenmapleridge.com is accessible and provides the primary evidence. The address (22805 Lougheed Highway, Maple Ridge, BC) and phone (604-463-0001) are confirmed on the website; OSM had no phone listed. The menu explicitly labels several dishes as '(Vegetarian)' and the site features an online ordering page, confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling amenity appears anywhere on the site. The OSM name 'China Kitchen Restaurant' differs from the website's consistent branding 'China Kitchen Maple Ridge', flagged in concerns.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'China Kitchen Restaurant' but the website consistently brands the business as 'China Kitchen Maple Ridge'.
Phone number (604-463-0001) appears on the website but is absent from the OSM record; contact_confirmed.phone set to null as there was no OSM value to compare against.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, long-established restaurant at a confirmed address with an active website, online ordering, and a full menu. A useful resupply stop for touring cyclists on Lougheed Highway.
